Results.ReviewText:
Bought the Ironwood 650 about 3 months ago and have used it at least once a week. Overall it is a good pellet grill. I upgraded from my 13 year old Lil Tex that has been an awesome and reliable grill. The 650 is quick on the startup, easy to control, and the wifi is almost perfect. Two things I do not like compared to my old Traeger. One is the grill does not produce as much smoke even in Super smoke mode. Most of the smoke goes out the grease drain, not the vent on the back. The door does not seal as well either as the seal on mine is to thick an holds the door open a little. This in turn allows heat out specifically by the control unit that seems to get quite hot. Also I end up with a lot of ash on my food which I never had with the old Traeger.  I believe the fan on this new Trager is to powerfull and blows ash all over inside the grill and it also cycles too fast in super smoke mode and will not allow the pellets to produce enough smoke.
    The Traeger wifi app has 2 issues. First issue is the probe alarm only alarms on the grill, not on you phone through the app. Kind of useless to have unless you sit right by the grill so you can hear the alarm. Second issue is the app disconnects every time your phones screen timer turns of the screen. So, everytime you pick up your phone to check things, you have to wait for it to reconnect before you get any information and sometimes it just plain locks up and will not connect. 
    Overall I like the grill. I just wish Traeger would tune the fan a little more and I think it would be an excellent grill.

Results.ReviewText: This is my third Traeger.  I started with a Big Texas, then went to the Select Elite, and now this Ironwood 885.  Every one of them has been an upgrade and I'm very impressed with this grill.  The packaging and ease of assembly was very impressive.  I didn't think I would find much use for the wifi controller and phone app, but I was very mistaken on that.  I LOVE IT!  It's so nice to be able to run errands while your brisket or ribs or whatever is cooking and monitor the actual temperature and make adjustments if needed.  No more wondering if the temperature is where it should be or not.  Not only does this controller adjust in 5 degree increments, but the grill stays at the commanded temp much better than previous models.  Traegers have never imparted as much smoky flavor as other real smokers, but with their "super smoke" mode, it modulates the fan off and on, and although I haven't really decided how much more smoky it makes it, I applaud the effort.  Startup and shutdown seems to take longer than previous models, but that's not a big deal and what I love is how quickly it will get hot once it's going.  I timed it - only 4 1/2 minutes to get from 180 degrees to 350 degrees!  Overall, I love this Traeger and consider it it be a very worthwhile upgrade.
Results.Title: Best Traeger yet!

Results.ReviewText: I have been looking to purchase a Traeger for some time and finally decided it was time when the Ironwood came out. It has all the features I wanted like WiFi control and double wall insulation. As soon as I put the grill together I threw on a 14lb brisket and two racks of ribs for a 4th of July cookout. Brisket took 9 hours at 225 Ribs 4 hours. My neighbors were impressed with the flavor and juiciness of the meat. They couldn't believe this was my first go. I used the Traeger app to search for the recipes and downloaded them to the WiFire controller. I was able to monitor the temp throughout the day using the app and the meat probe. I would highly recommend this model to anyone looking for a feature packed pellet grill. It does take minute to fire up and power down but once fired up can get up to 500 degrees in no time. Hopper holds an entire bag of pellets and I didn't even burn through them all with the grill on for 14 hours straight. Cleaning was easier than I thought especially with the included drip pan liner and bucket liner.
Results.Title: This is THE pellet grill you WANT and NEED
